$comment: Limits of text slots that no visible box measures (read by packages/cms/tracy-quickstart-tools/content-coverage/emdash-content-map.mjs into the content map). A number needs a real source: a box that was measured (how is said in `from`; Playwright, Chromium, 1440 / 768 / 390 px, on a clean install of this theme, perf/slot-measure.mjs) or a field's schema maxLength (none of these fields declares one). A text no page draws in a box has no number: it is declared `nonVisual` with where it is used, and the kit asks no limit of it.

limits.from: the site title is used only in the document `<title>` and `og:site_name` (Base.astro), and as the logo's alt text when neither the logo nor the business name has one (brand.ts): no page draws it in a box and the setting declares no maxLength, so it has no limit (the business name the footer prints is its own slot, chrome.brand_name, which is measured)

the business name is printed as visible words only in the footer copyright line (Footer.astro, `{name}` of `copyright`); filled with Latin running text until the line gains a row beyond today's rows (Playwright, Chromium, clean install of this theme, perf/slot-measure.mjs): 161 characters at 1440 px, 70 at 768 px (one row), 64 at 390 px (two rows)
